name: Peter, James, and John
role: Ancient apostles who restore priesthood keys in the D&C
dateNote: Section 27, dated August 1830, says they had already ordained Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery apostles.
importance: Peter, James, and John were apostles of Jesus in the New Testament. Section 7 presents a record of John’s wish to remain on earth and gives the three keys of ministry. Section 27 says the Lord sent them to ordain Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery apostles and gave them the keys of the kingdom. Section 128 places their voice between Harmony and Colesville on the Susquehanna River, without giving a date.
connections: They appear with Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery, and alongside John the Baptist, who section 27 says conferred the lesser priesthood.
reviewNote: Checked the heading and verses of D&C 27 on the official page and 128:20 in the local text. Described only as the revelations present them. The date of the higher priesthood restoration is not recorded in the D&C; historians usually place it in May–June 1829.
